title: Summit Upgrade Rules: Complimentary, Certificate and Miles Upgrades
content:
This document sets the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program rules for waitlisting and clearing upgrades.

**Request.** A member may waitlist an unflown segment of a ticket that names the membership for an upgrade by exactly one upgrade method: complimentary, certificate or miles. An upgrade is requested only on a ticket whose fare brand is upgrade-eligible in the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter, that is a ticket on Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible or Crestline Premium Economy. Crestline Basic Economy is never upgraded and Crestline First has no higher cabin.

**Complimentary upgrades.** A complimentary upgrade is available only when the member's tier holds the complimentary upgrade entitlement. It clears no earlier than the tier's clearance window in hours before departure, and competes with other requests by the upgrade priority rank of the tier held on the flight date, ties broken by the earlier request date.

**Certificate upgrades.** A certificate upgrade consumes the tier's certificates per segment for a domestic or short-haul international segment and the tier's certificates per long-haul international segment, drawn from the batch expiring first, and may be requested at any time after ticketing. Certificates are consumed only from a membership whose status is active.

**Miles upgrades.** A miles upgrade costs the tier's miles per segment for segments up to the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter's segment length threshold for the ticket, and the tier's miles per longer segment on longer segments. The former wording that a miles upgrade costs those miles "plus the tier's miles upgrade co-pay per segment" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the co-pay of a cleared miles upgrade.

**Award tickets.** On award tickets, complimentary and certificate upgrades are available only when the member's tier allows upgrades on award tickets.

**Companion.** When the member's tier permits a companion upgrade, one companion on the same reservation is upgraded together with the member for no additional certificates or miles.

**Charging.** Certificates and miles are charged only when the upgrade clears; a request that never clears costs nothing.

**Expiry.** Certificates not used by their batch expiry date expire the following day, batch by batch, and are never extended or reissued.

**Repeat requests.** A segment already confirmed in the higher cabin by a paid upgrade is never waitlisted again.

| Fare brand of the ticket | Upgrade can be requested |
|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | No |
| Crestline Main Cabin, Main Plus, Main Flexible, Premium Economy | Yes |
| Crestline First | No higher cabin |
